title: Activation Play: Operator Enablement & Release-note Choreography for Private/VPC (RBAC, Audit, KMS)
creator: Morgan Patel
description: Purpose: Orchestrate the operator-facing activation (operator images, credentials, docs) and the public release notes/comms for the Private/VPC on‑prem feature set (RBAC, audit logging, KMS integrations). This ticket centralizes coordination across Product, Eng, Design, Support, Security, and GTM so customers receive a cohesive activation experience and compliant rollout. Scope includes: operator bundle readiness, operator docs & quickstarts, release-note content and templates, cross-team timing, training for operator teams, and post-activation telemetry targets. Out of scope: feature development and bug fixes (tracked on ENG tickets).
acceptance_criteria: Operator container images published to support registries (ECR/GCR) with semantic tags and signed manifests
Operator Helm/OCI install manifests validated on test cluster templates (VPC and air-gapped permutations)
RBAC, Audit, KMS docs merged and published in docs.redwood.ai/private-operator with clear preflight checklist
Release notes drafted, reviewed by Security and Legal, and approved for GA publication
Operator enablement runbook and support playbook created and triaged with Support and SRE
Customer enablement assets (1-pager, onboarding checklist, recorded walkthrough) produced and assigned to CS
Telemetry signals (install success, auth failures, audit log throughput) instrumented and baseline dashboards created
rollout_steps: Preflight (Week -3): freeze docs snapshot; security review kickoff; operator smoke tests scheduled
Stage release (Week -2): publish staging operator images and internal install guides; run 3 customer pilot installs
Documentation & Training (Week -1): finalize quickstarts; record 45-min walkthrough; internal office hours scheduled
GA Launch (Day 0): publish release notes, enable operator images to public registries, announce to customers and community
Post-launch (Day 1-14): monitor install telemetry, triage issues, push critical patches as needed
deliverables: Helm/OCI install manifests and air-gap instructions
RBAC policy examples and migration notes
Audit log configuration guide and retention recommendations
KMS integration guide for AWS KMS and customer HSM flows
success_metrics: <5% install failure rate across pilot cohort within 48 hours
>80% of pilot customers complete enrollment without on-call intervention
Release notes viewed by 70% of active private deploy customers within 72 hours
Telemetry pipelines report RBAC/audit metrics within 24 hours of install for >=90% of installs
risks_and_mitigations: Risk: operator image signing or registry access blocked for air-gapped customers -> Mitigation: provide offline bundle + SHA-signed artifacts and clear checksum validation steps
Risk: RBAC templates too permissive -> Mitigation: ship conservative templates plus prescriptive least-privilege examples and a validation CI job
Risk: KMS integration exposes credential handling ambiguity -> Mitigation: security sign-off + HSM walkthrough + sample KMS policy snippets
Risk: support surge after GA -> Mitigation: schedule two days of on-call engineering coverage and prepare triage runbooks
notes: Unique coordination note: use a ‘release choreography’ model where each team owns a 48-hour handoff window (Docs -> Eng -> Support -> GTM). For air-gapped customers, prioritize the offline bundle and a dedicated verification script. We will run two internal dry-runs (one with internal infra, one with partner lab) before GA. Prepare an embargoed customer FAQ for pilot customers. Legal must review release notes no later than 72 hours prior to GA.
